_note: The team as an organisation: who reports to whom, what each person is good at, and why they are here. Read by engine/tasks.js (get_org_chart). Kept apart from data/staff.json, which the simulator reads for hours, pay and task speeds. Skills are plain words; `owns` are the records each person is the usual first answer for, which decides who replies in staff chat (sim/team-chat.mjs). Someone hired at run time (set_staffing add) reports to the first person their role reports to.

S-01.why: Owns the shop. Signs off anything big and takes complaints nobody else could settle.

S-02.why: Keeps the books honest and the cash in the bank. Two mornings a week.

S-03.why: Day-to-day bookkeeping: invoices in, money owed, the ledger.

S-04.why: Gets parcels out of the door and knows every carrier by name.

S-05.why: Runs the stock room: deliveries in, counts, shelves.

S-06.why: Leads the help desk and picks up anything a customer is unhappy about.

S-08.why: Answers customers, mostly by email and chat.

S-09.why: Decides what to buy, from whom and when.

S-10.why: Gets the word out: posts, newsletters, campaigns and the press.

S-11.why: Mends things at the Fix Club bench.
